units.sentence: Input · Nov 18, 2026, 10 a.m.: Speak at the Fulton County Board of Commissioners' public comment, in person or by Zoom; the Board adopts the budget.
units.evidence_span: Residents have two options to participate in public comment: in person and virtually via Zoom.
units.problem: Each fact is supported: Nov 18 10 a.m. meeting (P-039), in person or Zoom (P-067), the full Board adopts (P-014). But read alone under a dated 'Act now' heading, '; the Board adopts the budget' can be read as adoption happening on Nov 18. Adoption is due by the second regular January meeting (P-005), expected Jan 20 (P-041).
units.suggested_fix: ...in person or by Zoom. The Board, which must adopt the budget by its second regular January meeting, hears public comment at each regular meeting.

units.evidence_span: All virtual public comments and requests to speak in person must be submitted before the clerk sounds the start of the 10 a.m. meeting.
units.problem: Vague read alone: it doesn't say which requests (Zoom comments and requests to speak in person) or how to reach the Clerk.
units.suggested_fix: Zoom comments and requests to speak in person are due before the 10 a.m. start; call the Clerk at 404-612-8200.

units.sentence: By Nov 15, 2026: The Budget Commission, two commissioners and two county staff, must propose Fulton County's 2027 budget to the Board of Commissioners.
units.marker: {analysis: the county code sets "no later than November 15" for the following year's budget (P-005); P-008 lists the members}
units.problem: Quote 'no later than November 15' is verbatim in P-005; the 2026 date follows from 'for the following year'.

units.sentence: Expected by Jan 20, 2027: The Fulton County Board of Commissioners must adopt the 2027 budget by its second regular January meeting, which the proposed schedule sets for Jan 20.
units.evidence_span: by no later than the second regular meeting in January of the year to which it applies

units.sentence: Nov 4, 2026: Fulton's Board of Commissioners voted to file, or set aside, a resolution to end a limit holding departments' requests to 5% above current funding.
units.evidence_span: to remove the 5% cap placed on all Fulton County departments for the 2027 budget
units.problem: Minor: 'holding departments' requests to 5% above current funding' is FOX 5's description (P-077), stated here as fact. The workspace calls the limit's exact terms uncertain because no written instruction was found.

framing_issues.text: Input · Nov 18, 2026, 10 a.m.: ... ; the Board adopts the budget.
framing_issues.issue: Under a dated 'Act now' heading, '; the Board adopts the budget' can be read as adoption on Nov 18. Adoption is due by the second regular January meeting, expected Jan 20 (P-005, P-041), and no record puts the budget on the Nov 18 agenda.
Vague read alone: which requests (Zoom comments, requests to speak in person) and where to submit them aren't said.

framing_issues.text: a limit holding departments' requests to 5% above current funding
framing_issues.issue: FOX 5's description of the limit (P-077) is stated as fact. The workspace calls the exact terms uncertain because no written instruction was found.
